verdict.rationale: Agent trace runs can be exported in open formats: markdown, JSON, or a ZIP of markdown plus screenshots. Steel is also open source, ships a self-hostable Docker image, and works through standard CDP with Puppeteer, Playwright, or Selenium, so leaving the managed cloud is realistic. However, there is no documented account-wide export covering all user data. Missing for 10: comprehensive all-data export (sessions, persistent profiles, credentials, files, replays), documented migration/offboarding path, independent corroboration of export completeness.
